subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should OpenClaw retire the shipped `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` config contract now, using this doctor migration, rather than preserving it until a real gRPC exporter is implemented?
rationale: Both directions can be technically coherent, but removing an accepted value from released configuration is a product and upgrade-policy choice that tests cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve HTTP-only contract
options.body: Merge the narrowed contract and doctor repair, accepting that operators must migrate to an OTLP/HTTP collector before re-enabling affected telemetry.

options.title: Preserve gRPC acceptance
options.body: Pause this PR and retain the released schema until OpenClaw implements a real gRPC exporter or chooses another backward-compatible transition.

recommendation.title: Approve HTTP-only contract
recommendation.body: Merge the narrowed contract and doctor repair, accepting that operators must migrate to an OTLP/HTTP collector before re-enabling affected telemetry.

likelyOwner.reason: The original diagnostics OTel configuration history most directly connects this person to the shipped contract being changed.
